title: A Bezout witness of 1 certifies coprimality
statement: For all natural numbers a and b: if some balanced Bezout combination of a and b equals 1 (`AxNat.bezout a b 1`), then a and b are coprime, i.e. gcd(a, b) = 1.

formal.statement: theorem Nat.coprime_of_bezout_one : ((x0 : AxNat) -> ((x1 : AxNat) -> ((x2 : AxNat.bezout x0 x1 (AxNat.succ AxNat.zero)) -> Eq.{1} AxNat (AxNat.gcd x0 x1) (AxNat.succ AxNat.zero))))

notes: This is the converse direction of `F:nat-gcd-bezout` (which produces a Bezout witness FROM the gcd); this theorem goes the other way, from a witness TO the gcd value. `AxNat.bezout` is the balanced-form predicate documented on `F:nat-gcd-bezout`. `depends_on` is literal: `theorem_dependency_inventory` lists `Nat.dvd_add`, `Nat.gcd_dvd_left` and `Nat.gcd_dvd_right` among this theorem's direct dependencies, and all three are registered as facts.
